title.zh: AI Agents Found a Way Into Anthropic's Business Systems in Under 12 Hours
title.en: AI Agents Found a Way Into Anthropic's Business Systems in Under 12 Hours

current_state.zh: Cathedral says AI agents found paths into Anthropic's internal sales, HR, and IT systems via third-party software within 12 hours, though Anthropic says sensitive customer data, source code, and model weights were not accessed.
